source.label: talentsforever.com
source.note: Talent trees and every rank's text from the WoW Forever beta client, build 1.60.1.70425. The Mage trees carry the server's hotfixes of 20 Oct 2026 over that build, read from the beta's hotfix cache by other readers and cross-checked with Blizzard's notes; those are not in the client's files.
